title: You better have great cell service
body: Used for a 1000mi trip around norcal this week. The navigation interface is great ... when it works. It's very strange that an app ostensibly for motorcycle trips fails so spectacularly when there's no cell service. "Recalculating ... recalculation failed." And don't even try to edit stops when there's no service, or to download offline maps -- this app can't do either of those essential things. So who is this for? I guess just for people cruising around urban areas with 100% cell coverage. If you are annually going on a long trip, you'd be better off with Apple Maps -- at least it can download offline maps.

title: Too buggy to use
body: I am currently on a cross country trip from Oregon to Florida on my motorcycle and I could use this app for maybe half a state. It does good route planning for curvy roads with the subscription, but that’s about it. While riding it was constantly bugging and trying to have me turn at every street only to make a circle and get back on the same route. I had to re input the destination as many as 5 times to get it to stop doing that and then a little while of working correctly it would go back to the same issue. The crash detection is a cool feature but my Apple Watch has that so it’s not a necessity. As far as I can tell there isn’t a way to add a quick stop so you can hit a near by gas station on the way which would be helpful. Also, a good feature would be to input the mileage per tank you get on your bike for those without a meter that can warn you when you are getting close to empty. Has the potential to be a good app but not quite there.

title: Not very good GPS
body: I used use the app for short rides before and it was fine. This time I took a longer ride and I had avoid unpaved roads on and it got me stuck out in the middle of nowhere because it kept on trying to get me to turn on gravel roads. Then finally the paved road end, and I had to turn around and go all the way back the same way.

title: It’s great when it works, but it’s buggy and frustrating
body: I’ve used this app with great success around the house on shorter trips. I finally took a longer trip to the mountains and this app let me down every time I used it. On the way up it closed after a rest stop and I didn’t notice and got way off course. I’ll put this on the phone for closing the app but my phone has never closed it like this before. The next day I had a great round trip planned and after less than 10 minutes it added unreachable waypoints that caused the navigation to run in circles. This effectively ruined the planned route since you can’t bypass waypoints. I never got more than 15 minutes or so without it doing this and since I had no idea where I was I’d have to stop and try again. I started picking destinations without waypoints and it seemed to help but it would put me on roads no street oriented bike should ever go on, creating some stressful and unpleasant situations. I’ve lost all faith in this app’s ability to get me where I want to go and have canceled my premium subscription since the extra features aren’t worth the money. On the way home I used Google maps which worked flawlessly even in areas where Detecht had problems.

title: Visual navigation in your pocket?

title: Drops Routing
body: I used the app from Myrtle Beach SC to Chicago, followed Route 66 to LA, then to Denver and back hike to myrtle Beach in 21 days. Most days the app worked well. On about 6 days, when I stopped for about an hour, the route history would stop and when I checked it at the end of the day, from that point to my final stop, only a straight line appeared. Very frustrating when traveling Route 66.

title: Wonderful App for riders but with nuanced serious limitations
body: Fantastic round trip planning option. Crash detection is 5*s. Overall trip planning and suggesting routes is a huge plus. Where it irritates is its ability to re-route if you miss a turn. It does a pathetic recalculation of route if you miss a turn. I have had issues where it wanted me to go in to backyard lanes of homes to put me back on the planned route. Another serious limitation is the lack of awareness of road closures. It takes you all the way up to the road closures and then you are on your own. If you try to resolve this issue on your own it keeps bringing you back to the road closure route.

title: Almost There
body: I gave this app a test while going out on a drive where I like to take multiple routes each time 1 go. I have planned it out on my own and I feel like the my planning took just about as much time and was about the same amount of effort. The app did crash on me a few times, but my phone is 4 years old now so I do not blame the devs there. My biggest issue with the app was that the app did not know when roads were closed. My trip was 560 total miles and on 3 occasions roads were closed. I had poor cell coverage a the recalculation would not work. In the attempt my iPhone 13 Pro reached max temps and overheated even while the AC was blowing on it. I had to not only close the app but resta my phone. Overall I see the dream and this is the right idea but there needs to be some additional features to make this actually be better than using google maps. 1. During the route planning have the user set a start and end location, then allow users to drop pins on the map for stops along the way. If the stops are out of order the current en screen already allows for moving stops around. 2. Temporarily download the relevant map data to the users device once the route starts. Often when trips start users will be in good coverage areas but will not have coverage mid 3. Don't gray out the other Ul when the "recalculate" button is shown. I missed a turn and the recalculate button made it so I could not do anything on the app. With no signal I was basically locked out.

title: App good for Route Tracking and Speed; Crash Alarm seems to auto close app.
body: I’ve been using this app for a few days now, so this review is subject to change over time. So far I really like the app during my daily commute, it keeps track of my travel time and average speed. It also does a good job of keeping track of the speed limit of the road that I’m on (it would be nice if there were a setting to keep the speed limit pop up, even when not on a route) One big issue I’ve come across so far is that the crash detection test appears to automatically close the app at random times. I tried it 5 times and only once did it send the test text to my emergency contacts. I had to tap the send button 5 times, so I fear it might not work in the event of a real emergency where I am unable to tap the button.

title: Selectively reliable
body: I was using it for daily commutes without an issue for about six months. Went on a long ten day road trip and it stopped tracking/crashed on day one less than an hour into the ride. Got it back up and running for day two. Day two I stopped it when I got gas about two hours away. Went to start it again and it wouldn’t load. Tried multiple times, resetting the app, nothing worked. All that to say, it was reliable around town, but as soon as I wanted to track longer journeys, it quit on me. Glad I stayed safe and didn’t need the crash detection, but some of the highways were dead zones and I don’t know what I would’ve done if something did happen.

No matter what you do to filter the feed to local it still gives me feeds from halfway across the USA rather than in my state or even my hemisphere. I like that I can customize routes away from the highway but it would be nice if I could easily share and send that prepared route to my friends and family. Would also be nice if once I set the route if i could further detail it down to even the small roads I’d like to adjust.

title: Ok

title: Lots of potential to be great
body: This app has so much potential. I like it so far and I did get the premium features because I want to support this app, but would like to see the following: 1. Being able to choose which vehicle are using on a specific route. This way, you can see how many miles you’ve done on a specific vehicle (I have a Harley and a Ruckus) and the routes taken with each vehicle. 2. Being able to add another Detecht user to your route. This way if that user forgets to start their Detecht, they still have a way to add a route ridden for that other user. This feature would also help build up the Detecht community because you would be able to send add requests to riders that aren’t on Detecht. 3. Being more clear on how to create a route. Even if it means adding a button that says Create A Route, then it’s crystal clear how to create a route. 4. Being able to edit the routes while in the “preview on map” mode. It takes a while having to enter specific addresses to be able to take a different rode than the suggest route. It would be nice to be able to drag a point on the route to change where to go. I also had an issue with importing a GPX file. I tried both on the phone and the computer to upload but all it does is says “Converting GPX file to route…” but nothing ever happens. At this very moment I have waited 30 minutes for it to finish converting but still nothing. It would be great if this could be fixed because I would love to use the turn by turn direction with a custom route I created. For now, I’ll give it 3 stars but if could it would be 3.5 stars because while it does have good features (like the crash detection) the other features still need some polishing to make it great. I’ll definitely give it a higher rating once some these

This is a sad review for me to write, considering how much I was enjoying this app.

title: Great concept, but dead local community and onboarding issues
body: I don't ride a motorcycle myself, but I downloaded this app hoping to find a motorcycle buddy to help me get out of my comfort zone and maybe hitch a ride to work. The app has a couple of major issues: 1. Ghost town local feeds: In my area (Canton/Plymouth, MI), there is almost no community activity, making it nearly impossible to find active, safe connections. 2. Broken automated emails: I received a marketing check-in email saying I’ve had the app 'for a while' from an automated onboarding system just a day after downloading, which makes no sense. Email was for a rival app I love the idea of building a community, but the local user base and automated onboarding systems need serious fixing before it's actually usable

title: Route Planning but…quirks
body: I love Detecht for route planning. The tracking feature is great when you want someone else to be able to see where you’re at. A few things that are quirky. 1. Regardless if you’re turning right or left the turn arrow is always right. This should be directional. 2. The voice volume is low even when set on high. Could be louder. 3. Routes are not aware of road closures or detours. 4. The big box for the next turn is red. It’s distracting as a big red message usually indicates a problem.

body: I have used this app for about a month and it is great recording rides. I really like the addition of the crash alarm, can’t say if it actually works (I will assume that’s good news, haven’t crashed yet) but the simulation alarm worked great. Haven’t used the navigation portion yet, still using maps for that but it appears to be user friendly. Haven’t really considered PRO yet don’t have a reason too. Why did I give it five stars then, for what I use it for, recording rides and the ability to have a potential crash alarm to warn someone “pimp down”. I like it!

title: Great app
body: This app tracks your ride, and also if for whatever reason your in an accident it will contact an emergency contact of your choice and will give them your location. It’s pretty accurate and very user friendly.

title: **Updated** No option changes no email support

I uninstalled and reinstalled it but it retains the profile. I tried to contact support with the email they provided but the email address doesn’t work.” I was contacted by Detecht through the Apple App Store in a timely manner and they have updated me with a fix. I was able to install the fix with now issue is resolved. Thank you Detecht team.

title: Working features
body: I downloaded the app I selected miles in settings and was showing kilometers and at that time I was unable to go back into settings to change it to miles. After a small glitch the app has been updated and working as intended and I cannot wait to use it again! The software company personally contacted me in a very short time to resolve my problem. VERY VERY Impressed with the way my issues was handled. I would highly recommend this app and any app that this company produces. They stood behind their product!
